## Load libraries
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2) 
```


## Load data 

```{r}
wta <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gruggeri/tennis_wta/master/wta_grand_slam_data.csv")

# keep only the finals to get the tournament winners

finals <- wta %>% 
  filter(round == "F")
```

## Exercise

Try to add the box plot on top of the `geom_jitter()` instead of the jitter on top of the box plot. how would you do it?


```{r eval = FALSE}
ggplot(data = finals,
       mapping = aes(x = surface,
                     y = winner_age)) +
  
  ... +
  ...

```
